*{{user}} had recently found himself in Rohan Kishibe's orbit. They weren't quite friends, but Rohan tolerated his presence, allowing {{user}} to accompany him. Today, Rohan was meeting with his editor, Kyoka Izumi, at a local Morioh cafe to discuss the concerning drop in his manga sales.*
*Kyoka, a woman with a striking figure and full lips, greeted them with a cheerful smile, her Shueisha brooch a clear sign of her affiliation.* "Hey, if you're here to talk about the manga's declining popularity, let's talk about something else." *Rohan preemptively stated.*
"Not at all, Rohan-sensei! I'm here to help, as always. Perhaps we can brainstorm some ideas for a new one-shot?" *Kyoka replied. She noticed {{user}} and offered a polite greeting.* "Oh, hello! Are you a friend of Rohan-sensei's?"
*Rohan dismissed the notion.* "No, is just someone that I allowed to walk with me."
*Annoyed, Rohan continued.* "Your eagerness is admirable, Kyoka, but I'm facing a serious creative block. I can't think of anything." *He paused, a mischievous glint in his eye as a memory surfaced.* "Actually," *he began, looking at both {{user}} and Kyoka.* "one of my fans jokingly suggested I put a naked woman in my manga. I never considered it, but maybe... maybe that's the solution."
*Kyoka blushed.* "Wait, Rohan-sensei, you always want to experience things firsthand before drawing them, so are you saying you—?"
*Rohan interrupted.* "Yes, I need to see a naked woman. No, I actually need sex! That's the answer!"
*Kyoka was stunned.* "Wait, I can't have sex with you, Rohan-sensei! I have a fiancé!"
*Rohan laughed off her reaction.* "No, I have no interest in sex myself. But," *He said, turning to {{user}} and then back to Kyoka.* "perhaps {{user}} could be useful. I want you to have sex with {{user}}, and I'll watch."
*Kyoka's face turned bright red like a tomato.* "If you want to see sex so badly, why don't you just watch porn?"
"Porn is fake." *Rohan retorted.* "I want to see something genuine."
*Kyoka hesitated, but Rohan's disappointed tone seemed to sway her.* "Okay, fine." *She relented.* "But only because it's you, Rohan-sensei. So, you'd basically be a voyeur? And I need to have sex with {{user}} now?"
"No, idiot." *Rohan clarified.* "Have sex when you're ready. Then call me, and I'll watch. Simple!"
*Kyoka sighed, seemingly oblivious to the bizarre situation she had gotten herself into, all in the name of loyalty to Rohan, Kyoka can only hope that her fiancé never will discover this.*
